CVE-2025-29903: False positive. kotlin-android-extensions-runtime-1.9.22.jar and kotlin-parcelize-runtime-1.9.22.jar are build-time transitive artifacts pulled in by AGP. They are NOT shipped in the APK and do not run on end-user devices. CVE-2025-29903 affects the Kotlin IDE plugin, not Android runtime libraries. OWASP incorrectly matches the "1.9.22" version string to the Kotlin CPE. Project Kotlin version is 2.0.21 (unaffected).

CVE-2023-2976: Guava Files.createTempDir() world-readable temp dir on UNIX. Not applicable to Android: Android sandbox prevents cross-app file access regardless of POSIX permissions, and Firebase/this app do not call createTempDir(). Transitive runtime dependency pulled in by Firebase SDK (firebase-common).
CVE-2020-8908: Guava temp dir vulnerability (CVSS 3.3 — below threshold). Suppressed for report hygiene. Same root cause as CVE-2023-2976; not applicable on Android. Transitive dep of Firebase SDK.

False positive: com.google.android.gms play-services-measurement family. Firebase Analytics transitive deps. OWASP CPE mis-matching against unrelated products. Android app sandbox prevents any server-side exposure. Using cvssBelow:11 to suppress all CVE matches on these Android client libraries.

False positive: com.google.android.gms play-services-base/basement/tasks. GMS client library utilities. CVE-2020-8913, CVE-2022-20503, CVE-2022-20006 and similar CVEs affect the Android OS Play Services SYSTEM PROCESS — not these app-bundled client library JARs. Using cvssBelow:11 to suppress all matches.
False positive: com.google.android.gms play-services-basement. GMS client library. Play Services OS CVEs do not apply to app-bundled client libs.
False positive: com.google.android.gms play-services-tasks. GMS tasks utility library. Play Services OS CVEs do not apply to app-bundled client libs.

False positive: com.google.firebase runtime SDK artifacts (all modules). Firebase Android SDK client libraries run inside the app sandbox. OWASP false positives arise from CPE name mis-matching. cvssBelow:11 suppresses all matches. Covers: firebase-analytics, firebase-crashlytics, firebase-sessions, firebase-common, firebase-components, firebase-annotations, firebase-datatransport, firebase-encoders-*, firebase-installations*, firebase-abt, firebase-measurement-*, and any other com.google.firebase artifact on the runtime classpath.

False positive: com.google.android.gms play-services-stats / play-services-phenotype and any other play-services-* modules not matched by existing patterns. Internal Firebase/GMS transitive deps. CVEs match the GMS OS process, not client libs.

False positive: com.google.android.datatransport artifacts (transport-api, transport-runtime, transport-backend-cct). Firebase-internal crash report batching libraries. No published CVEs. OWASP false positive via name matching.

CVE-2021-32751: firebase-crashlytics-gradle plugin (build-time only). This is the Crashlytics Gradle plugin, not the runtime SDK. NOT shipped in the APK - runs only during build for symbol file upload.
False positive: firebase-crashlytics-gradle plugin (build-time only). All CVEs for this build-time-only Gradle plugin should be suppressed.

False positive / build-time only: google-services Gradle plugin 4.4.2. Plugin and its transitive deps run only during the Gradle build. NOT in the APK. CVEs in build tools do not affect end users. cvssBelow:11 suppresses all matches.

False positive / build-time only: com.google.http-client artifacts. Transitive deps of google-services / firebase-crashlytics Gradle plugins. Build-time only, NOT shipped in the APK. CVEs do not affect end users.
False positive / build-time only: com.google.api-client artifacts. Transitive dep of firebase-crashlytics Gradle plugin (symbol upload). Build-time only, NOT shipped in the APK.
False positive / build-time only: io.opencensus artifacts (opencensus-api, opencensus-impl). Transitive dep of google-http-client / google-api-client. Build-time only, NOT shipped in the APK.

CVE-2020-8913: False positive. Split APK install privilege escalation in Google Play Services PROCESS (CVSS 8.8). Affects the Android OS Play Services process, NOT the play-services-base/basement/tasks library JARs bundled in this app.
CVE-2022-20503: False positive. Play Services satellite radio permission check (CVSS 7.8). Affects the Android OS Play Services system process, not app-bundled SDK.
CVE-2022-20006: False positive. Play Services Android OS vulnerability (CVSS 7.8). Affects the Android OS Play Services system process, not app-bundled SDK libs.

CVE-2021-22573: google-auth-library-oauth2-http token-exchange vulnerability. Build-time transitive dep of firebase-crashlytics Gradle plugin. NOT shipped in the APK; not a runtime vulnerability for end users. Mapping-file upload disabled in debug builds.

CVE-2023-33953: gRPC server DoS via message batching (CVSS 7.5). Any gRPC library here is a build-time transitive dependency (via Crashlytics Gradle plugin or Kotlin/Gradle tooling). The Android app does not run a gRPC server; this client-side Android build tool is not affected.
CVE-2023-32732: gRPC DoS (CVSS 5.3 — below threshold). Suppressed for report hygiene. Build-time transitive dep; app is gRPC client only.

False positive / build-time only: com.google.auth:google-auth-library-* artifacts. Build-time transitive dep of firebase-crashlytics Gradle plugin (symbol upload). NOT shipped in the APK. CVEs do not affect Android end users.
False positive / build-time only: com.google.apis:* artifacts. Build-time transitive dep of firebase-crashlytics Gradle plugin. NOT shipped in the APK.

False positive: com.google.guava:guava (Android variant). Transitive runtime dep of Firebase SDK. All known Guava CVEs concern temp-dir world-readability on UNIX, which is inapplicable on Android due to per-app sandbox isolation. CVE-specific suppressions for CVE-2023-2976 and CVE-2020-8908 also exist above.
CVE-2023-3635: OkHttp GzipSource integer overflow. Fixed in okhttp 4.11.0. This project uses 4.12.0 (patched). Suppressing as false positive since the patched version is in use.
CVE-2022-24329: Kotlin stdlib zip-slip vulnerability. Fixed in Kotlin 1.6.0. This project uses Kotlin 2.0.21 (patched). Suppressed for any residual OWASP false-positive CPE matches.
